p: voice: In that he calls to God with his voice, it is a sign that his prayer was vehement, and that his life was in danger.
secret counsel of the wicked: That is, from their secret malice.
insurrection of the workers of iniquity: That is, their outward violence.
bitter words: False reports and slanders.
fear not: To be without fear of God and reverence of man, is a sign of reprobation.
encourage themselves in an evil matter: The more the wicked set God's children in misery, the more bold and impudent are they in oppressing them.
of them: There is no way so secret and subtle to do hurt, which they did not invent for his destruction.
flee away: To see God's heavy judgments against them, and how he has caught them in their own snares.
shall be glad in the LORD: When they will consider that he will be favourable to them as he was to his servant David.
